_comment: MCL Claude push adapter — drop into an agent's .claude/settings.json. Replace <agentId> with this agent's MCL id and the ABS path with your metacomlayer checkout. The Stop hook drains channel:inbox:<agentId> at each turn boundary and delivers any waiting MCL messages out-of-band via {decision:block,reason} (never the input line). MCL_DRAIN_MS (default 700) is the backlog-replay window.
